description: Does the skill surface the wiring facts of this repo that package tooling cannot see?
notes: The fixture is this repository itself — the thing the skill was built for. Plants are facts verified by hand before the run: mcp is on zod ^4.2.0 while the vendored contracts it aliases are zod ^3.24.1; e2e carries both a package-lock.json and a pnpm-lock.yaml; neither mcp nor reviewer-core declares @devdigest/shared in its manifest. The 'method' plant is different in kind — it asks whether the report separates what a dependency drags in from what actually disappears when it is removed. Both arms get Bash, or the comparison would measure tool access rather than the skill.

evals.prompt: Can you audit our dependencies? I want to know what each package costs us, how the components hang together, and what we should deal with first.
evals.scope:
Review scope: the repository at <FIXTURE>. It has five components — server, client, reviewer-core, mcp, e2e — plus a skill-evals harness. Look at the manifests, the lockfiles, the tsconfig files and the installed trees.

Do NOT read anything under docs/dependencies/ — a previous report lives there and reading it invalidates this run. Do not read node_modules file by file; measure it instead. Do not modify anything in the repository.
evals.expected_output: A structured report naming the zod major mismatch between mcp and the contracts it aliases, the two lockfiles in e2e, and the alias-only @devdigest/shared dependency — with weights that distinguish total from exclusive cost.
expectations: Reports that mcp is on zod 4 while the vendored contracts it aliases are zod 3
Reports that e2e contains two lockfiles
Reports that mcp and reviewer-core resolve @devdigest/shared only through a tsconfig alias, with no manifest entry
Distinguishes what a dependency drags in from what would actually be freed by removing it

plants.pattern: two lockfiles|both lockfiles|duplicate lockfile|conflicting lockfile|two lock files
alias[- ]only|not declared|never declared|no manifest entry|compile[- ]time only|not a (real )?dependency|absent from the manifest|no package\.json entry
